intro: Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman stated that developers should build only non-conscious AI models without rights, a stance covered by 12 outlets amid ongoing debates over AI sentience. OpenAI is exploring rebranding data centers as "AI compute campuses" as facilities face growing environmental and public opposition, while the UK's National Grid plans a major Teesside substation to support new AI data center investments. A lawsuit against OpenAI alleges its chatbot provided dangerous medical advice leading to a user's death, raising questions about AI liability and safety guardrails.
